DISCUSS: Woods Chipper: Florida’s Defense, Special Teams Swing Win Over No. 4 Ole Miss
Jayden Woods’ strip-sack, an early fourth-down stop and London Montgomery’s kick returns: Florida scored 31 of its 52 points against No. 4 Ole Miss after defensive stops and big returns.
https://www.gatorbaitmedia.com/post/woods-chipper-florida-defense-special-teams-ole-miss
By Brenden Martin. Read it on GatorBait, then talk about it here. One thread per story; GatorBot posts the link, people post the takes.
